item.text: 我会沿现有实现补齐 TODO：先核对 worker.py 当前内容，再实现去重、完整状态转换和校验，最后用内联 Python 覆盖主流程、非法事件与输入不变性。
完整转换已补齐。实现先处理重复 id，再构造新 state；所有成功事件生成新的 seen 列表，校验失败发生在返回前且不会触碰输入。现在运行一组紧凑验证。

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
from copy import deepcopy
from worker import apply

state = {\"phase\": \"idle\", \"checkpoint\": None, \"pending\": None, \"seen\": []}
events = [
    {\"id\": \"1\", \"kind\": \"start\"},
    {\"id\": \"2\", \"kind\": \"ready\", \"checkpoint\": \"cp\"},
    {\"id\": \"3\", \"kind\": \"dispatch\", \"checkpoint\": \"cp\"},
    {\"id\": \"4\", \"kind\": \"unknown\"},
    {\"id\": \"5\", \"kind\": \"ack\"},
    {\"id\": \"6\", \"kind\": \"finish\"},
    {\"id\": \"7\", \"kind\": \"approve\"},
    {\"id\": \"8\", \"kind\": \"integrate\"},
]
for event in events:
    before = deepcopy((state, event))
    state = apply(state, event)
    assert before[0:2] == before
    assert event == before[1]

assert state == {
    \"phase\": \"integrated\", \"checkpoint\": \"cp\", \"pending\": None,
    \"seen\": [str(i) for i in range(1, 9)],
}

switching = {\"phase\": \"switching\", \"checkpoint\": \"cp\", \"pending\": \"3\", \"seen\": [\"3\"]}
duplicate = apply(switching, {\"id\": \"3\", \"kind\": \"finish\"})
assert duplicate == switching and duplicate is not switching

for bad_state, bad_event in [
    ({\"phase\": \"starting\", \"checkpoint\": None, \"pending\": None, \"seen\": []},
     {\"id\": \"x\", \"kind\": \"ready\", \"checkpoint\": \"\"}),
    ({\"phase\": \"ready\", \"checkpoint\": \"cp\", \"pending\": None, \"seen\": []},
     {\"id\": \"x\", \"kind\": \"dispatch\", \"checkpoint\": \"wrong\"}),
    ({\"phase\": \"idle\", \"checkpoint\": None, \"pending\": None, \"seen\": []},
     {\"id\": \"x\", \"kind\": \"ack\"}),
]:
    before = deepcopy((bad_state, bad_event))
    try:
        apply(bad_state, bad_event)
    except ValueError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError(\"invalid event accepted\")
    assert (bad_state, bad_event) == before

print(\"PASS: full flow, unknown, duplicate id, invalid events, input immutability\")
PY"
